name: findskills
description: One skill that loads every other skill on demand from your FindSkills profile (your own skills, kept in the cloud), so skill descriptions stay out of your context. Finds community skills (skills.sh, GitHub) when you ask for one.

auto_route.title: Suggest a skill on each prompt
auto_route.description: on: before Claude reads each prompt, FindSkills checks your profile and names the skill that clearly fits. The prompt (without code blocks or secret-looking lines) is sent to the FindSkills hub. Needs findskills login.
